$comment: Phase 0.2 Medium-tier planner task set. 10 structural-JSON plan-generation tasks scored 0-100 against Perplexity-Max gold plans in bench/gold/planner-medium/. Structural-JSON conformance is a hard-pass gate before quality scoring. Authored per ADR-0022. SHA-256 hashes for each gold file are stored in gold_hashes and MUST match at run time. Task-set is frozen: any change requires a superseding ADR and a version bump.

tasks.notes: Endpoint + auth + tests. Discriminator: dependency sequencing (helpers before endpoint, endpoint before tests).
Zero-downtime discipline. Discriminator: migration deployed before code changes.
Invariant-preserving refactor. Discriminator: explicit backward-compat via wrappers.
Cache-invalidation discipline. Discriminator: explicit invalidation on write, not TTL-only.
Cross-repo dependency ordering. Discriminator: publish before depend.
Rate-limiting patterns. Discriminator: auth-aware key function.
OTel patterns. Discriminator: auto-instrumentation vs. hand-instrumenting every handler.
Coexisting APIs. Discriminators: (a) service-layer sharing, (b) DataLoader, (c) REST preserved.
Incident-response ordering. Discriminator: mitigation before RCA.
Project-specific conventions (ADR-0019). Discriminator: does the plan reference the MCP port range and mode wrapper explicitly?
